# CUX · Airspace awareness & self-defence (CUX)

<!-- generated by tools/build.py from curriculum/syllabus.yaml — do not edit -->

The defensive half of module 14 and module 18, on its own: finding another aircraft in the sky, holding a track on it, identifying it from its Remote ID, reporting it with a record that survives a week, deconflicting against it, and breaking a track taken on Hermon. Hermon is the sensor and the evidence throughout — nothing in this track attacks anything, and every lesson states the limit of what this airframe can honestly do.

**6 lessons · ≈ 7 h 30 min** · [Course map](../../COURSE_MAP.md) · [Dependency graph](../../curriculum/dependency-graph.md)
